config.script:
if self.view.params.action == "confirm":
		logger = system.util.getLogger("Status")
		# ── Retrieve view parameters ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
		data          = self.view.params.payload
		serial_number = self.view.params.payload.serial_number
		event_type_id = self.view.params.event_id                                  # 32 = Cancel event type
		userName      = self.session.props.auth.user.userName
		machine_id    = self.view.params.payload.machine_id
		remarks = self.view.params.reason
		logger.info("Cancel event triggered | serial_number={} | event_type_id={} | userName={} | machine_id={}".format(
		    serial_number, event_type_id, userName, machine_id
		))
		
		# ── Branch: machine_id is available → read live tag values before inserting ───
		if machine_id is not None:
		    logger.debug("machine_id is not None, fetching basePath for machine_id={}".format(machine_id))
		
		    # Get the tag base path for this machine from the database
		    query    = "Machines/GetMachineByID"
		    data     = system.db.execQuery(path=query, parameters={"ID": machine_id})
		    basePath = data.getValueAt(0, "basePath")
		    logger.debug("basePath resolved: {}".format(basePath))
		
		    # Build RO (Read-Only) and RW (Read-Write) tag path lists for the machine
		    ROtagPaths = wo.machine.build_tagpath_RO(basePath)   # e.g. wip, actual_num_turns etc.
		    RWtagPaths = wo.machine.build_tagpath_RW(basePath)
		    logger.debug("ROtagPaths: {}".format(ROtagPaths))
		    logger.debug("RWtagPaths: {}".format(RWtagPaths))
		
		    # Read current machine tag values
		    ROresult = wo.machine.get_machine_status(ROtagPaths)
		    RWresult = wo.machine.get_machine_status(RWtagPaths)
		    logger.debug("ROresult raw: {}".format(ROresult))
		    logger.debug("RWresult raw: {}".format(RWresult))
		
		    # Extract wip and actual_num_turns from RO tag results
		    wip              = ROresult[0].value
		    actual_num_turns = ROresult[1].value
		    logger.info("Live tag values | wip={} | actual_num_turns={}".format(wip, actual_num_turns))
		
		    # Insert the cancel event into wo_event_history
		    EventQuery = 'ecs/workorder/op_event/insertEvent'
		    params = {
		        "serial_number"   : serial_number,
		        "event_type_id"   : event_type_id,
		        "userName"        : userName,
		        "wip"             : wip,
		        "actual_num_turns": actual_num_turns,
		        "machine_id"      : machine_id,
		        "remarks"	      : remarks
		    }
		    logger.debug("Executing insertEvent with params: {}".format(params))
		    system.db.execUpdate(path=EventQuery, parameters=params)
		    logger.info("insertEvent executed successfully for serial_number={}".format(serial_number))
		
		    # Update op_status in work_orders to reflect the cancel event
		    updateOpStatus = 'ecs/workorder/op_event/updateOpStatusInWOLocal'
		    system.db.execUpdate(path=updateOpStatus, parameters={
		        "serial_number": serial_number,
		        "status"       : event_type_id
		    })
		    logger.info("op_status updated | serial_number={} | status={}".format(serial_number, event_type_id))
		
	#	    # Build the tag write list to reset machine WO tags on cancel
	#	    taglist = [
	#	        "{}/WO/PO".format(basePath),                        # [0] PO number
	#	        "{}/WO/serial_number".format(basePath),             # [1] Serial number
	#	        "{}/WO/Start_time".format(basePath),                # [2] Start date
	#	        "{}/WO/status".format(basePath),                    # [3] Machine work status
	#	        "{}/Supervisor/Job_Cancel_requested".format(basePath), # [4] Job cancel request flag
	#	        "{}/WO/Program_Name".format(basePath),              # [5] Program name for machine
	#	        "{}/Supervisor/LastAction".format(basePath)         # [6] Last action taken by supervisor
	#	    ]
		    logger.debug("Writing tags: {}".format(RWtagPaths))
		    system.tag.writeBlocking(RWtagPaths, ['', '', "", 0, False, '', event_type_id])
		    logger.info("Tag write complete for basePath={}".format(basePath))
		    system.tag.writeBlocking(["[default]Ignition_Project_Config/Sup_updated_wo"], [True])
		
		    # Refresh the page view and close the confirmation popup
		    system.perspective.sendMessage('refreshCancel', scope='page')
		    system.perspective.sendMessage('refresh', scope='page')
		    system.perspective.closePopup('confirm')
		    system.perspective.refresh()
		    logger.debug("refreshCancel message sent and confirm popup closed")
		
		# ── Branch: machine_id is None → insert event with zeroed production values ───
		else:
			eventID = 2 if event_type_id == 18 else event_type_id
			logger.warn("machine_id is None | serial_number={} | defaulting wip=0, actual_num_turns=0".format(serial_number))
			
			# No machine linked — use zero values for wip and actual_num_turns
			wip              = 0.0
			actual_num_turns = 0.0
			
			# Insert the cancel event with zero production data
			EventQuery = 'ecs/workorder/op_event/insertEvent'
			params = {
			    "serial_number"   : serial_number,
			    "event_type_id"   : eventID,
			    "userName"        : userName,
			    "wip"             : wip,
			    "actual_num_turns": actual_num_turns,
			    "machine_id"      : machine_id,
			    "remarks"	      : remarks
			}
			logger.debug("Executing insertEvent (no machine) with params: {}".format(params))
			system.db.execUpdate(path=EventQuery, parameters=params)
			logger.info("insertEvent executed (no machine) for serial_number={}".format(serial_number))
			
			# Update op_status in work_orders
			updateOpStatus = 'ecs/workorder/op_event/updateOpStatusInWOLocal'
			system.db.execUpdate(path=updateOpStatus, parameters={
			    "serial_number": serial_number,
			    "status"       : eventID
			})
			logger.info("op_status updated (no machine) | serial_number={} | status={}".format(serial_number, event_type_id))
			system.tag.writeBlocking(["[default]Ignition_Project_Config/Sup_updated_wo"], [True])
			
			# Refresh the page view and close the confirmation popup
			system.perspective.sendMessage('refreshCancel', scope='page')
			system.perspective.sendMessage('refresh', scope='page')
			system.perspective.closePopup('confirm')
			system.perspective.refresh()
			logger.debug("refreshCancel message sent and confirm popup closed (no machine branch)")
	elif self.view.params.action == "delete":
		LogID = self.view.params.LogID
		params = {"LogID":LogID}
		system.db.execQuery(path="Operator Overview/deleteDowntimeLogBySup", parameters=params)
		system.perspective.closePopup('confirm')
		system.perspective.sendMessage('refreshBinding', scope='page')
